name: KeyValuePair
description: Provides information about the tags that are associated with an S3 bucket or object. Each tag consists of a required tag key and an associated tag value.

allOf.description: One part of a key-value pair that comprises a tag. A tag key is a general label that acts as a category for more specific tag values.
One part of a key-value pair that comprises a tag. A tag value acts as a descriptor for a tag key. A tag value can be an empty string.
